variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.sub: A governing party has left the colony's government.
variants.body:
A party has walked out of the government in {colony}. The departure is a change in the governing arrangement, not a complete account of its consequences. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of leaving from assumptions about parliamentary strength or a successor ministry.

Working people need more from parties than a performance of falling out. Cooperation matters when it helps secure a decent life; a break deserves scrutiny for the same reason. Labour should ask whose needs are being defended, without allowing claims about those needs to stand in for evidence.

The conduct of {target} should be examined in the light of the departure itself. This paper does not attribute an unreported motive to the break or announce an unreported governmental outcome. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.sub: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement.
variants.body:
Cooperation in government has reached a break: a party has walked out. The event raises the question of what parties owe an arrangement they enter. For {target}, responsibility should be considered without pretending that the report supplies the departing party's reasons or the administration's next steps.

Working people need more from parties than a performance of falling out. Cooperation matters when it helps secure a decent life; a break deserves scrutiny for the same reason. Labour should ask whose needs are being defended, without allowing claims about those needs to stand in for evidence.

The conduct of {target} should be examined in the light of the departure itself. This paper does not attribute an unreported motive to the break or announce an unreported governmental outcome. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.sub: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}.
variants.body:
Leaving a government is a political act with institutional significance. A party has taken that step in {colony}. Its effect on the governing relationship is the subject of this report; judgments of {target} should not depend on an invented dispute, ultimatum or distribution of seats.
